labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Joplin is a free, open source note taking and to-do application, which can handle a large number of notes organised into notebooks.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: Joplin

dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:debiantrixie

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG JOPLIN_VERSION
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE=Joplin \
    NO_GAMEPAD=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/joplin-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  if [ -z ${JOPLIN_VERSION+x} ]; then \
    JOPLIN_VERSION=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/laurent22/joplin/releases/latest" \
    | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/joplin.deb -L \
    "https://github.com/laurent22/joplin/releases/download/${JOPLIN_VERSION}/Joplin-$(echo ${JOPLIN_VERSION}| sed 's/^v//g').deb" && \
  apt-get install -y \
    /tmp/joplin.deb && \
  mv \
    /usr/bin/joplin \
    /usr/bin/joplin-real && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/* \
    /tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001
VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
- Improved: Add a first-class OpenAI provider using the Responses API (#16864) (#16450 by [@Rygaa](https://github.com/Rygaa))
- Improved: Create the application authorisation ID in one place (79d954a)
- Improved: Prioritize local changes to sync info over values with unchanged far-future remote timestamps (2624b35 by Henry Heino)
- Improved: Sync/E2EE: Avoid propagating share/publish status until an item has decrypted (b6692eb by Henry Heino)
- Fixed: Fix ENEX import failing when an unescaped ampersand is directly followed by a tag (e5ed69a)
- Fixed: Fix crash when a semantic search result is open in a secondary window (#17085)
- Security: Add UI to allow validating public key fingerprints when sharing notebooks (3fd2f2f by Henry Heino)
- Security: Ask for confirmation before disabling E2EE (f4447dd by Henry Heino)
- Security: Detect and allow recovering from invalid public-private key pairs (27944cf by Henry Heino)
- Security: Disable unencrypted uploads by default when E2EE is enabled (cfce373 by Henry Heino)
- Security: Fix SQL injection in data API (64522e0 by Henry Heino)
- Security: Harden master key loading, add new encryption method forward compatibility (46c5442 by Henry Heino)
- Security: Harden server share API response handling (64d513a by Henry Heino)
- Security: Prevent OneNote import from reading files outside the import directory (86250d4)
- Security: Sync/E2EE: Do not mark items as published based on the list of shares returned by the server (2d1a179 by Henry Heino)
- Security: Sync/E2EE: Harden marking items as published/shared (3cf1c1a by Henry Heino)
- Security: Sync: Do not allow a remote item to decrypt/deserialize to an item with a different ID (b61ef1e by Henry Heino)
